briefs.name: Pocket Timeline, Relit
briefs.hypothesis: All eight lenses told the lineage to keep its spine, and none faulted the idea. It came last because of what was draped over the idea: pixel type on everything people read, a moss four-green ground, khaki double frames, berry for NOW and for late, small targets and no late marking on To do. Remove that costume and keep only the handheld's friendly shapes: the lens-shaped tube, her name plate on the box, cartridges, square stops and the dotted future. Draw the spine as the fine line art the owner calls high style, and light only what is live. The page then reads top to bottom as the family's time: NOW is where you write, NEXT glows on the glass, Coming up hangs on the line and LATER runs on dotted. Carried through Chat, Plans, To do, Status, Settings and the form, that is a system, not an effect, and it keeps a personality the leaders lack.
briefs.brief: Start from r11-wild-1. Copy /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/tour/t1-a/variants/r11-wild-1/ (sheet.css; templates home.html, tasks.html, plans_month.html, login.html, 404.html) and palettes/r11-wild-1.json. Add a copy of the repository's templates/_ask.html (for the title) to templates/. 1. PALETTE (tokens) - bg #0a0e0c, a neutral green-black; it was the (17,26,17) moss. - surface #12171a, surface-2 #161c20, surface-3 #1b2227, field #0d1214. - line #222a2e, line-2 #2e373c, edge #5d6a72 (3.2:1), card-edge #2b3338. - ink #d2d8d2 (13.4:1, calmer), ink-2 #b8c0bb, dim #97a19c, faint #86908b. - heading #dcd8cb (bone); label #a9b6bf (steel; the green-yellow pea label is gone). - accent #9db6d6 (denim links); bezel #2a2f35 (graphite plastic, not the navy #232631); bar #101418. - bubble #111712 (her glass), bubble-them #1a2127 (slate). - lit #86d9a6, halo #6dff9c, brand and screen #6dff9c. - glow 0.95, screenGlow 1.0, topGlow 1.0. - Keep the kind and section colours. shows #e57694 now only means Wishes and the kids. In sheet.css :root: - Retire --moss, --moss-2, --spine-c, --pea, --berry, --indigo and --hard. - Add --spine #4b5963, --stop-edge #6b7a84, --plastic var(--bezel), --plastic-edge #3d444c. - Set --shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.035), 0 1px 0 #0008. No hard 4px drop anywhere. 2. TYPE SYSTEM (written as tokens; Nunito retired) - --title: Pixelify Sans 600 2.5rem/1.1, for inner-page h1 only; 40px lands whole pixels. This is the handheld's voice, which type, style, usability and system allowed. - --question: Instrument Sans (wdth 85) 600 clamp(2rem,3.6vw,2.625rem)/1.08, -0.015em, with a true curly apostrophe. - --head: Instrument Sans (wdth 88) 600 1.375rem, for section heads. - --panel: Instrument Sans 600 1.125rem, for panel heads. - --name: IBM Plex Sans 600 1.0625rem, for a thing's name in a row. - Body: IBM Plex Sans 400 1rem/1.55. - Lede: 1.125rem/1.5, max 58ch. - Small 0.875rem; fine 0.8125rem, with a floor of 12.5px. - --fig: IBM Plex Mono 500 0.875rem with tnum and zero, sentence case, no tracking. Use it for every date, time, count and "in 2 days". - --stop: Silkscreen 1rem, letter-spacing 0.02em (was about 0.12em). Use it only for the stop words NOW, NEXT, LATER, TODAY and SOMEDAY. - VT323 only inside .crt-tube. - Buttons, tabs and links: Plex Sans 600 0.9375rem, sentence case. - Heads use text-wrap: balance; paragraphs use pretty. 3. THE SPINE AND ITS STOPS (every page; one shape, one meaning) - The spine is a 2px #4b5963 line at --spine; it was 4px moss. - Draw it per section: `.timeline > .stop::before` on Home and `main::before` elsewhere, ending at the last stop. The dotted tail (2px dashes on a 6px gap) is its own element, `.stop.later::after` or `.list-tail`, running to the column's foot. This replaces the fragile masking trick. - Stops are 14px squares: a 2px --stop-edge on var(--bg), with a 3px bg gap ring. The rail from a stop to its label is 2px. - NOW: a solid lit square with background radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb,var(--brand) 42%,#fff) 0 30%, var(--brand) 70%) and box-shadow 0 0 0 3px var(--bg), 0 0 6px var(--brand), 0 0 18px color-mix(in srgb,var(--brand) 45%,transparent). It is steady, never berry. - NEXT: a hollow 2px #6dff9c square whose halo breathes on a 3.2s cycle (kit E20). - LATER and SOMEDAY: a dashed 2px steel square, unlit. - A section stop: a hollow steel square. - Late: a 2px amber (#eaa85d) edge, never filled. - Done: lit-sage fill with a check (E21). - Stop words (.stop-word) are in --stop. NOW and NEXT are #6dff9c with the E1 halo (0 0 .45em brand/.45, 0 0 1.3em brand/.22); NEXT uses the dimmer phosphor. LATER is steel #a9b6bf. - On inner pages the title tile is the first stop. It is a 44px lit tiny screen (E11): the Lucide icon glowing in the section accent, a 1-in-3 raster, a 1.5px accent-mixed edge and 4px corners. 4. BAR AND FOOT - .bar is var(--bar) at 88%, with the E6 top haze under it. - Replace the berry-and-indigo trim pair with one 1px #2e373c hairline. - The current place (a[aria-current], .menu.here > summary) is a filled steel cell: #1f272d with a 1px top highlight and a 2px accent cap on its bottom edge riding the hairline. Its icon is lit in the accent (E11 drop-shadow). - Words are shown for Memory, Family, Status and Settings from 72rem up: show `.tools .label`. - Icons: copy /home/user/FamilyDB/src/familydb/web/static/icons.svg to variants//static/icons.svg. It is the Lucide line set, at 1.75 stroke and 18-20px. Keep every the parent's sprite had (see its sprite.py). Draw only i-mark, the smiling monitor, on the pixel grid, in #6dff9c with E2 bloom and the blinking caret. - The wordmark "FamilyDB" is Pixelify 600 20px. - Phone tab bar: six equal 3.5rem cells, each a Lucide icon over a Plex Sans 600 12.5px word. The current one is a solid slate tile (#1f272d) with a 2px accent cap and no halo. - Foot, the handheld's chin: a 1px steel rule; the mark and wordmark; the tagline upright at 15px ink-2 (not italic); legal at 13px faint; the four slanted speaker slots in steel at 15%. 5. HOME Layout: `.home` columns are minmax(38rem,1.6fr) minmax(21rem,1fr) with a 3rem gap. The timeline is on the left and the shelf on the right, both align-self:start. Aim for a Home no taller than about 1650px. NOW - The stop is the lit NOW square, the lit "NOW" word, and the date "Tuesday 29 September" in --fig steel. - Her name plate on the box (L036): `.welcome .speaker` sits on the box's top edge at 1.25rem in. It shares the box's 1px edge, has 4px top corners and no bottom edge, and holds her glyph screen (E19, 28px) and her name in Plex Sans 600 16px. Its edge lights var(--lit) while `.ask:focus-within`. - The box (`.welcome .ask`) has one 1.5px frame, color-mix(in srgb,var(--brand) 38%,var(--line-2)). Radius is 4px 4px 14px 4px, echoing the handheld lens. Fill is rgb(9 12 11/.72). - The box's light: E4's resting halo (0 0 38px -20px brand/.6), and brand edge plus 3px ring plus 30px bloom on focus. Inside it, E7: radial-gradient(70% 90% at 0% 100%, brand/.13, transparent 62%), with the masked scanlines (white 2.8%, 1px in 4) on ::before. - `.ask-question` is in --question, bone. The title is "What’s the plan?", with .glow #6dff9c under E1. - The textarea is Plex Sans 17px. - Ask bar: From and the select at 44px; "Send where I am" with a 44px hit square; the mic as a 44px round plastic key. - Send is the one primary: #6dff9c, Plex Sans 600 16px, 44px tall, radius 4px. It keeps E3's ring and pool, plus one bevel step, a 2px inset lip at the bottom in #2f9e5c. Hover is E3's hover with a 1.2s afterglow. - Ways to start (.starters a) are plastic keys: #1b2227 with a 1px #2e373c edge, 44px, Plex Sans 500 15px ink-2, with an 8px gap. - Her last line sits on glass (#111712, 1px brand 28% edge), with "Continue with Vera" as an underlined denim link. NEXT - The stop is the breathing NEXT square and the lit "NEXT" word. - The tube sits in the handheld lens (L018, thinned): - Case (.crt): linear-gradient(#30363d, #262b31), a 1px #3d444c edge, radius 10px 10px 36px 10px, 0.5rem sides and a 0.9rem bottom. It keeps inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.08) and E12's 80px phosphor spill. - Trim (.crt::before): two 1px steel hairlines. The engraved legend now says something, "RADAR · 4 WEEKS", in Plex Mono 500 10px .08em #7e8a92, aria-hidden. It replaces "PHOSPHOR DISPLAY". - Power LED (.crt::after): #6dff9c with a 6px glow; it was berry. - Tube: E13 (VT323 1.5rem, three halos, 0.35px blur on the words only), E14 (scanlines, sheen, falloff), and the dot matrix on .crt-tube::after at 6% alpha or less, checked at 1x. Keep E15's inverse NEXT UP, bright title, [TODAY] and cursor, and E17's radar at 8.5rem with hub, sweep afterglow and the next blip pinging. - Size the glass to its words (align-self:start), with no empty band. Scope nowrap to .next-more. COMING UP - A section stop, with "Coming up" in --head bone. - Rows (.agenda > li) hang on the spine, and each date leaf is its row's stop, centred on the spine. The leaf is 3rem by 3.5rem: #1b2227, a 1px #2e373c edge and a 2px top cap in plans cyan at 55%. It reads "Oct" in Plex Mono 500 11.5px dim, the day in Instrument Sans 600 1.5rem tnum, and "Thu" in Plex Mono 11.5px. No Silkscreen. - Row grid: leaf | body | a 7.5rem facts column. - The title is --name, as a link underlined 1px at a 3px offset in line-2, turning to a lit-sage underline on hover. - The when line is Plex Sans 15px ink-2. - .rel "in 2 days" is right-aligned in --fig dim, nowrap. - 1px solid #222a2e hairlines separate rows; no dashes anywhere. - A plan today lights its leaf's edge #6dff9c with an 18px halo and a lit TODAY word. - Row hover: a 10% steel wash with a 2px sage inset edge, fading over 1.2s (L228). LATER - The dashed stop, the steel "LATER" word, and "All plans →" (Plex Sans 600, denim, underlined, 44px). The dotted tail runs on to the column's foot. SHELF Trays are #12171a with a 1px #2b3338 edge and 2px radius. Heads are --panel with an 18px Lucide icon in the section colour. Head links are sentence case, underlined and 44px, in the section colour. - Finish setting up (.panel.setup): the fill stays neutral slate with a 1px amber edge #8a6a35. Steps are numbered in 20px square amber-outline boxes (Plex Mono 13px), square like the stops, with underlined links. - To do (.home-todo): 44px rows. - The tick is a 44px hit square around a visible 20px well (#1b2227, 1.5px #5d6a72). A late tick has an amber edge (L255). - The title is Plex Sans 600 16px. - Meta: the owner in 14px dim, then the due words in --fig, "was due 2 days ago" in amber #eaa85d and "due in 2 days, 19:56" in dim. - The kids' wishes: one line per kid, the name in shows and "0 open" in --fig. - Lately added: the cartridges seen by their spines, as one-line rows. Keep the .idea-card class on each row. - Each is 44px on #161c20 with a 4px end cap in its kind colour, the 16px kind icon, the title in Plex Sans 600 16px (ellipsis at one line), and who it is for right-aligned in 14px dim. - Hover lights the edge at 40% of the kind colour with an 18px halo, fading over 1.2s. - Something to eat: one slate row with the amber restaurant icon. 6. CHAT - The first stop is Vera's glyph screen (E19, 44px), with "Vera" in --title. - Set `.in-chat{--lane:6rem}`. Each message's time hangs left of the spine in a timetable margin: Plex Mono 500 13px tnum dim, right-aligned 12px short of the spine. Move `.said-by > span` there with li{position:relative}. The day is said once, as a steel stop "Sun 27 Sep". - Each message has a 10px square node on the spine. Hers is green-black glass with a 1px brand 45% edge and a 6px glow; the family's is steel. - Vera's bubbles hang left from the spine, up to 58ch: #111712, a 1px brand 28% edge, 2px radius. Her name is Plex Sans 600 14px in #86d9a6. - The family's bubbles sit on the right of the column (.said-them justify-content:flex-end), up to 46ch: #1a2127 with a 1px #2e373c edge and a 3px denim edge on the right. Their initial is a 32px amber-ringed square at the right end. Text stays left-aligned. - The line ends at the lit NOW stop beside the chat box, drawn as on Home with Send the one primary. - On a phone the lane is 2.75rem, times go back into the bubble head, and the family's bubbles are indented 2.5rem. 7. IDEAS - Title stop with the lilac tile, "Ideas" in --title and the lede. "Add an idea" is the only green button; Filter becomes a plastic secondary key (quietFilter). - "Save a thought for later" is a 44px slate fold on a stop. - All ideas / Restaurants is a latched pair. The current one is steel #5f7689 with a 2px #a9c4d8 top cap; the other is flat slate. - The filter tray and the radar lens sit side by side from 64rem, with the radar at 8rem and nowrap on .crt .dist. - A count stop reads "12 ideas" in --fig. - Cartridges in a 3-up grid: - Body #161c20 with a 1px #2b3338 edge, a 3px kind cap across the top and the top-right corner cut 8px. - Three 1px grip ridges at 10% white in the top-left corner. - Kind label in Plex Mono 500 12.5px in the kind colour, with its line icon. - Title in Plex Sans 600 17px, balanced. - Facts (drive, for whom) with 16px icons in Plex Sans 14.5px ink-2; #id in --fig faint. - Drop the pressed arrow triangle. 8. PLANS (month) - Title stop with the cyan tile and "Plans". List/Month as a latched pair. Month head: a section stop, "September 2026" in --head, and Earlier/Later as 44px plastic keys. - Agenda (.month-line): - Quiet weeks fold (L122): "31 Aug – 27 Sep" in --fig and "Nothing on." in 15px dim, on a small steel dash on the spine. - A week's label is a --fig tick on the spine. - Each day with a plan has its date leaf on the spine and "Thursday 1 October" in Plex Sans 600 15px, with the plan's title as a --name link and its time in --fig. - Today is the NOW stop: its leaf lit #6dff9c with a halo, the lit TODAY word, and its row on a slate tray (#12171a, 1px #2b3338) in place of the berry box. Past days show at 70%. - Hairlines, not dashes. - The pocket tube month (L071) stays beside the agenda, sticky from 62rem, in the thinned lens and sized to its content. - Make it `crt('month-screen', hidden=false)`. Each busy day's numeral is a link to its agenda row (a href "#d-{{ day.date.isoformat() }}", with that id on li.day), with its glowing blip. - VT323 numerals at 1.35rem; today as an inverse block; days outside the month dim; the key line with its cursor. - The trim legend reads "MONTH". 9. TO DO - Title stop with the lemon tile and "Things to do". "Add something to do" is the head's one primary; it opens #add, the fold on a stop. The time-zone note moves under the list as fine print. - Filters: Show becomes four one-tap latched keys, Open, Done, Cancelled and All (links ?status=…, the current one a steel cell), plus the Search field and a secondary Search key. Drop the Show select. - The count "4 shown (up to 100)." is the list's stop label, in --fig. - The list is `ul.tasks` (drop .cards). Every row's tick is its stop on the spine: a 44px hit area around a 20px square. Late ones have an amber edge; done ones are lit sage with a check. - Row grid: tick | body | facts | edit. - Eyebrow (L173): "Sun 27 Sep · 19:56" in --fig 13px steel, sentence case, or "Someday" in faint. - The title is --name, followed by "#4" in faint --fig. - Facts: the owner in 14px dim, and the due words in --fig, computed in the template as /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/tour/t1-a/variants/r13-idea-1/templates/tasks.html does it: due_words at lines 30-36, clock_today = config.FAMILYDB_APP.clock.today() at line 103, and late = task.status == 'open' and due and due[:10] < today_iso at line 137. "was due 2 days ago" is amber; "due in 2 days, 19:56" is dim. - The NOW stop (the lit square and the lit NOW word, in the lane) sits between the last late row and the first one to come. - Undated rows follow a dashed SOMEDAY stop, where the spine turns dotted. - "Edit, complete, or snooze" is a 44px sentence-case key with a pencil at the row's end. Its form opens across the row in a slate tray. - Show a reminder line only when one is set: "No active reminder." goes. - Hairlines between rows, and no target under 44px. 10. STATUS - Title stop and "Status". The three panels are slate trays, the first on a stop. - Lamps: on is the E20 lit dot (0.62rem, white-hot core, 8px and 18px halos, breathing 3.2s). Off is a 2px pewter ring #8794a2; red only when nothing can answer. Partly is amber half-filled. - Rows are 44px. - The spend tube sits in the thinned lens, with the legend "SPENT TODAY · LIMIT". 11. SETTINGS - Overview: the cards are slate trays under one stop, each with a small lit tile icon (E11), a Plex Sans 600 17px title and 15px ink-2 facts. "Needs a look" is an amber-outlined Plex Sans 600 13px sentence-case tag, and that card's edge is amber. - A settings page: the sibling pages are stops on the spine (.settings-nav a::before), 44px each. The current one is the lit square in a filled steel cell (#1f272d) with a 2px accent cap on its left. The save bar is a sticky plastic strip with Save as the primary. 12. NEW-IDEA FORM - Crumbs, the lilac + tile, "New idea" in --title, then one tray on a stop. - Fields: #0d1214 wells with a 1px #5d6a72 edge, 4px radius, 44px tall, in Plex Sans 16px. Labels are Plex Sans 600 14px ink-2. - Focus: E4, with a sage caret. - Selects use appearance: base-select, with a slate picker and a lit 4px square beside the chosen option. - Checks are 20px wells inside 44px hit squares. - Add it (primary) and Cancel (plastic), both 44px. 13. SIGN IN AND 404 - The handheld itself: a graphite case with 0.6rem sides, radius 16px 16px 48px 16px, and a green LED. The face tube keeps E22, and E16 powers it on from a line, starting at opacity .05. - "Sign in to FamilyDB" is Pixelify 30px. 14. ACCESS - Every lit edge has the 1.2s afterglow, plus E10 landed. - Focus is a 2px #6dff9c ring at a 3px offset, including checkboxes and select:open. - The kit's reduced-motion, more-contrast and forced-colours blocks, with .crt-tube > :not(.radar){filter:none} under more contrast.
briefs.borrows:
The judges' fixes, most cited first:
1. Pixel faces off everything people read. Asked in some form by all eight lenses: feedback and soul (heads in a sans), type (Pixelify for page titles and the stop labels only; a straighter sans in place of Nunito; less Silkscreen tracking), style and usability (pixel only for page titles, stop labels or the tube), system (page titles at most), interaction (the NOW stamp), skeptic (the mark and the stop labels). So Pixelify is kept on inner-page titles and the wordmark, Silkscreen on the five stop words, VT323 on the glass, and IBM Plex Sans, Instrument Sans and Plex Mono do the rest.
2. The ground back to green-black and the surfaces onto slate, off moss and olive (soul, system, skeptic, style, feedback).
3. Chunky double khaki frames cut to one thin edge and one bevel step, with the hard shadow gone (feedback, style, system).
4. NOW as the lit green lamp, not berry (feedback, soul). "Was due" in amber, not berry (interaction, skeptic). Style's berry "you are here" becomes the lit square.
5. 44px targets on Home and on To do's ticks and edit links (interaction).
6. Overdue tasks coloured on the To do page (usability, and the designer's own weakness). Done with the in-template clock from r13-idea-1's tasks.html.
7. Pixel icons replaced by clear line icons (usability).
8. The tube month's days made links to their week (usability; L071's caveat).
9. Cartridges in slate with a kind-coloured cap (skeptic), with item names in the body face (type, usability, style).

The lineage's own gems, kept with their caveats met: L018 (the lens with a legend that says something, trims to steel, LED to green), L036 (the name plate at 1px, sans), L071, L122 (tabular ranges), L136 (NOW lit green, tail as its own element), L173 (sentence case in mono).

Small borrowed fixes: L228's visible row afterglow (r13-mut-3), L255's amber tick box (r10-mut-4), L131's solid phone tab (r7-rand-1), and the universal fixes (words in the bar, sentence-case controls, underlined links, tabular figures, one control per filter, a filled steel "here").

The light comes back from phosphor_kit.md E1-E22 at glow 0.95 and screenGlow 1.0.
briefs.avoids: Type 4.2 and usability: pixel item names that wrap and misread ("Ooks Pork", 29 read as 89), and Silkscreen's loud tracked "IN 10 DAYS". Soul 5 and skeptic 4.3: the four-green moss ground reading as monochrome, a handheld LCD rather than a tube. Feedback, style and system: the khaki double frames and hard shadows. Interaction and skeptic: berry for NOW and for "was due" reading as an alarm, and 7 Home plus 25 To do small targets. Usability: no late marking on To do, unrecognisable pixel icons, and a month grid shrunk to a tube with dead days. The lessons' faults: an icon-only right bar, dashes that read as pending, a 'PHOSPHOR DISPLAY' costume legend, a madder power light, empty glass under Next up. The designer's own: the fragile masking trick for the dotted tail, cartridge titles wrapping in the shelf, and the one-sided chat.
briefs.title: What’s the *plan*? It is the family's own everyday phrase for exactly what FamilyDB does: the weekend, an outing, what goes on the calendar, what needs doing. It invites anyone to tell Vera one. "Plan" is the job's own word and it glows at the NOW stop, where every plan starts. At 16 characters it fits one line on a phone at 2.25rem. It keeps the old title's shape (a short question, one lit noun) and puts the planner's job in place of "mind".

briefs.name: Pocket Timeline, Traced
briefs.hypothesis:
The lineage's spine already is the kind of line art the owner loves, but it only positions things. It lights nothing, and its tube shows a radar that says nothing about time. Four gems, from designs that lost on their packages rather than on these devices, make the spine and the glass carry the family's time in light:
- Bench Scope's pulse trace fills NEXT's spare glass with the next four weeks.
- Grid Console's lit spine plugs each section in at a square node that lights only where something is live.
- Figure Ground's due queue turns To do into the same spine, with a lit NOW line between late and to come.
- Zenith Desk's meridian gives Chat a two-sided time axis.

With the lineage's main fixes applied, it becomes a pocket instrument where every line means time or order and every lit thing is live. That answers the soul lens (a tube, not an LCD) and the owner's line-art and glow notes at once.

briefs.title: What’s *next* for us? This is the timeline's own question, asked at NOW. It hands on to the NEXT stop and the four-week trace below, and the lit "next" shares their green, so the title, the lamp and the glass read as one line. "Us" is the family's own voice. It covers the whole job: the next outing or weekend, the next plan for the calendar, the next thing to remember or buy. It can be read as the family telling Vera something or asking her, which is what the box does. At 19 characters it fits one line on a phone. It differs from the refinement's "plan" on purpose: that one names the job, this one names time.
